purpose: Prefixes and next numbers for quotes, invoices and other documents.
tips: Changing a sequence doesn't renumber documents already issued.

config.sequences.field.pattern.label: Pattern
config.sequences.field.pattern.description: E.g.: INV-{YYYY}-{MM}-{COUNTER:4}. Tap a variable to add it.

config.sequences.field.current_counter.label: Current counter
config.sequences.field.current_counter.description: The last number used; the next document uses the following one.
